summary: Startup licensing now recovers on its own and says what it did: Pro is restored after a failed first read instead of silently dropping to Free.
notes: If CouchMode cannot read your saved Pro entitlement when it starts, it now retries the membership check automatically instead of leaving you on Free.
The retry is bounded: four attempts spread over about seven minutes, then it stops.
It stops immediately on a settled answer - a lapsed membership, an account with no qualifying tier, or a device limit - so it never keeps asking pointlessly.
Startup licensing decisions are now written to the log with a reason, so a failure can be diagnosed afterwards instead of disappearing silently.
The entitlement file is only reported as saved once it has been read back and verified.
Pricing, the 7-day trial, offline grace, tiers and device limits are unchanged.
knownIssues: Devices can only be released from the PC they are on; there is no in-app option to sign out of all devices.
Xbox full-screen availability depends on your Windows version, device support, region, and Microsoft rollout status.
Experimental: Xbox Full-Screen Experience depends on Windows system behavior. On some devices, controller navigation may not receive focus automatically and may require pressing the Xbox button once.
